checks: Compare every criterion explanation with exact original excerpt
Do not infer eligibility from nationality or missing documents
Course-specific December/January timing is not an exact calendar deadline
Distinguish no additional scholarship documents from graduate course requirements
Preserve funding exclusions and historical stipend year
Review localized error and PathFinder messages for clarity
Review editable profile, consent, document-library and deletion wording in Dari and Pashto
Review Oxford exclusion/status and counterfactual language without implying an award
Review retained-source navigation tags and preserve their unreviewed/incomplete status
Review blocked-page recovery, original URL retention and supplied-versus-fetched labels in English/Dari/Pashto
Review source approval, saved HTML/TXT privacy wording and Other options at 320/390/768/1280/1440 px
Bind semantic approval of the verified live output to actual source/output digests; never approve diagnostic metadata alone
Review credential-verification request, status and privacy export/deletion wording in English, Dari and Pashto; never imply issuer confirmation without an issuer record
Review the research check-date provenance strings (Last checked, automated source read warning, human source check) in Dari and Pashto; they stay UNREVIEWED until a fluent reviewer signs them off

Review the BY-12 guided field-mapping strings (title, explanation, source-line labels, degree/GPA/test/date labels, refusals and errors) in Dari and Pashto; they stay UNREVIEWED until a fluent reviewer signs them off
Review every pendingStrings row: the consent-required sentence must name the exact action being refused, and the status legend must describe the issuer's decision rather than BursYar's own check
approvalRule: An authorized fluent human must supply reviewer identity, timestamp and specific output digest before marking reviewed. Automated tests never approve translations.
